summary: This study describes the low-temperature atomic layer deposition (ALD) of gallium nitride (GaN) using tris(dimethylamido)gallium(III) and NH3 plasma. The process shows self-limiting behavior between 130–250 1C with a growth rate of 1.4 Å per cycle. The GaN films produced were crystalline on Si (100) at all deposition temperatures with a near stochiometric Ga/N ratio and low carbon and oxygen impurities. The study highlights the potential of ALD for GaN-based electronic devices.
